issues: First-paint shows empty grid for ~1-2s before /api/integrations resolves; consider a skeleton loader on the cards grid for perceived performance.

critical_code_review_comments: store.py:21 derives Fernet key from sha256(JWT_SECRET) — works but means rotating JWT_SECRET will silently destroy ALL stored integration tokens. Document this clearly OR force INTEGRATION_FERNET_KEY env var in production (with refusal to start if missing).

store.py:59 _decrypt_secrets uses prefix 'gAAAAA' heuristic to detect encrypted values — fragile. If a tenant pastes an api_token that coincidentally starts with 'gAAAAA' the system will try to decrypt it and return None. Better: track encryption per-field at write time via a separate '_encrypted_keys' marker list.

webhook_emitter.py:92 retries via asyncio.create_task with no persistence — if the FastAPI worker restarts mid-backoff, scheduled retries are LOST. For production, persist a 'retry_at' field on the delivery row and have a periodic APScheduler job pick up due retries.

webhooks.py:79 inbound receiver raises HTTPException(400) on signature failure — most providers (Stripe, Twilio, Helcim) retry on 4xx. Recommend returning 200 with ok:false in the body, OR returning 401 only for clear sig mismatch and 200 for transient/unconfigured.
integrations.py:51 _frontend_redirect uses FRONTEND_URL but falls back to '' which produces malformed redirect '/app/integrations?...'. Add a sanity assert at startup.

sync_engine.py:50 run_provider_sync uses 'async for' on a cursor while running sync_one inside — if a tenant's sync hangs >sync_interval, max_instances=1 prevents overlap but the in-flight tenant blocks others. Consider asyncio.gather with a semaphore per provider for fan-out.
registry.py public_catalog exposes 'fields' (including 'secret':True flags) — fine, but if any field.default is added later for a secret, it would leak. Currently safe.

Excellent data-testid coverage on Integrations.jsx + Webhooks.jsx (int-card-{key}, int-field-{key}, int-{key}-save/test/sync/disconnect-btn, webhook-row-{id}, webhook-event-{name}, webhook-new-secret) — fully automatable.
